result.instructions: Tools for Wobaka, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contacts did we add this week, and who owns each one?"; "Show me the open tasks due this week for Richard Hendricks."; "Move the Big deal opportunity to the Demo stage.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wobaka data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wobaka_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wobaka_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wobaka_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wobaka_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wobaka_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List active contacts (or archived ones with show_archived). Filter by search text, status, owner, tags, or company vs person. Wobaka API: GET /contacts.

query.description: Case-insensitive search across contact fields and custom attributes.

statuses.description: Only contacts with these status ids (from wobaka_list_statuses).

users.description: Only contacts owned by these member ids (from wobaka_list_members).

tags.description: Only contacts that have all these tags.

is_company.description: true for company contacts, false for person contacts.

show_archived.description: true returns archived contacts instead of active ones.

skip.description: Number of matching records to skip (default 0).

tools.name: wobaka_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Show one contact with its custom attributes and related contacts. Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id.

tools.name: wobaka_get_contact_feed
tools.title: Get a contact's feed
tools.description: Show the timeline of one contact: notes, messages, emails, automation messages and actions, each with a type field. Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id/feed.

tools.name: wobaka_list_contact_notes
tools.title: List a contact's notes
tools.description: List all notes on one contact, oldest first (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id/notes.

tools.name: wobaka_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List open tasks (or completed ones with show_done) across the company. Filter by assignee or search text. Wobaka API: GET /tasks.

query.description: Case-insensitive search over task description, note, and contact details.

show_done.description: true returns completed tasks instead of open ones.

users.description: Only tasks assigned to these member ids.

order_by.description: Property to sort by, such as due-at or created-at. Needs order_direction.

skip.description: Number of matching records to skip (default 0).

tools.name: wobaka_list_contact_tasks
tools.title: List a contact's tasks
tools.description: List all tasks for one contact, newest first (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id/tasks.

tools.name: wobaka_get_company
tools.title: Show the company
tools.description: Show the company name and id of the account this key belongs to. Wobaka API: GET /company.

tools.name: wobaka_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the company members (active and inactive) with their ids, for owner and assignee fields (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /members.

tools.name: wobaka_list_statuses
tools.title: List contact statuses
tools.description: List the contact statuses in display order, for status_id fields (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /statuses.

tools.name: wobaka_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines with their stages in order (not paginated). Use a stage id, not a pipeline id, when creating an opportunity. Wobaka API: GET /pipelines.

tools.name: wobaka_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact owned by the key's user. A person contact needs a first name, last name, email, or company; a company contact needs company. Wobaka API: POST /contacts.

status_id.description: Status id from wobaka_list_statuses; default if omitted.

attributes.description: Custom contact properties. At most 50 keys.

tools.name: wobaka_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one contact. The tool reads the contact first and keeps every field you do not pass, because Wobaka replaces the whole contact on update. Wobaka API: GET then PUT /contacts/:id.

attributes.description: Custom contact properties. At most 50 keys.

tools.name: wobaka_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task assigned to a company member, optionally linked to a contact. Wobaka API: POST /tasks.

contact_id.description: Related contact id; a task may have none.

due_at.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, for example 2026-12-01 or 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z.

tools.name: wobaka_create_note
tools.title: Add a note to a contact
tools.description: Add a note to one contact; the author and timestamps are set by Wobaka. Wobaka API: POST /notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a contact

tools.name: wobaka_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity on a contact in a pipeline stage. The contact, stage and assignee must belong to the company. Wobaka API: POST /opportunities.

stage_id.description: Stage id from wobaka_list_pipelines (not the pipeline id).

value_amount.description: Whole currency units; 0 when there is no value.

value_currency.description: Lowercase currency, for example usd, euro, or gbp.

tools.name: wobaka_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update an opportunity
tools.description: Change the given fields of one opportunity (for example move it to another stage). Fields you do not pass are kept. Set archived_at to mark it lost; set it to null to restore it. Wobaka API: PUT /opportunities/:id.

archived_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp to mark lost, or null to restore.
